frontier.hypothesis: The single surviving sw in the referenced-carrier form is not a property of the array spelling but of GCC 2.7.2 never deleting the LAST store to a frame object, so no referenced (non-strippable) donation carrier of any shape can reach zero traffic on this body.
frontier.mechanism: r7/r8 fold three of four store/load pairs and keep exactly one store, and r9/r10/r11 (a single site) keep one too, which is consistent with each write killing the previous write at the same frame address and the final write having no successor to kill it. GCC 2.7.2's flow.c insn_dead_p treats a MEM destination as live unless it can prove the object dead, and a donated assign_stack_temp block has no DECL to make that proof from.
frontier.next_probe: Read tools/gcc-2.7.2/flow.c insn_dead_p / mark_set_1 for the MEM-destination case and confirm whether a store to a frame object is EVER deleted; if it is, the enabling condition is the last unmeasured route to a zero-traffic referenced carrier, and if it is not, this closes the referenced half of the donation disjunction as a class kill with a predicate cite instead of the instance kill s21 could justify.

frontier.hypothesis: Four class-A combine orphans (8 bytes each, reload1.c:2382-2385) would buy the same 32 bytes at zero instruction cost, and they have still never been enumerated at the four narrow sign-extend sites with what-if lifts.
frontier.mechanism: combine.c:10832-10841 distribute_notes plants an orphan (insn (use (reg P))) when the defining insn is rewritten away; P then has no set and no constraint-bearing reference, regclass leaves it ST_REGS, find_reg cannot seat it and alter_reg pays 8 bytes for nothing. s9 measured that each such orphan is paid for with an emitted lh on this tree's other bodies, which would cost bytes here - that prediction is still untested ON this body, and s7 killed only the specific HImode sign-extend spelling, not the enumeration.
frontier.next_probe: Run tools/nrefs_census.py --func func_800480C0 --file text1b with what-if lifts on each loop pseudo, then count orphan USEs directly on each resulting .combine dump with tmp/grind/func_800480C0/s6/count_uses.py; the target is orphanUSE=4 at 72 cc1 insns with no lh appearing.

frontier.hypothesis: The honest record is now complete on mechanism, and the disposition is an owner row in engine/volatile_cheats.py::_SANCTIONED_UNWRITTEN_PADS rather than a spelling.
frontier.mechanism: The standing Judge constraint (docs/grind/decisions.md:20349) bars the unwritten pad for this body in any spelling until an owner ruling adds its row, and .claude/rules/no-new-park-categories.md:340-342 makes the family a closed per-function enumeration. s21 closed the last open family (donation) on a mechanism: the donated block must carry zero traffic to be byte-neutral, and a zero-traffic frame object is the pad.
frontier.next_probe: Do NOT re-spell the pad. Whichever session reaches the escalation modality should cite s21's r5/r6 (the target's exact .frame $sp,88 # vars= 32, regs= 8/0, args= 24 with the 74-instruction stream untouched, through an honest value-flowing helper) as the cleanest proof that the residual is exactly the 32-byte get_frame_size charge, alongside s20's h1 score-0 measurement, s19's additivity, and the s21 sibling-invariance table showing func_800480C0 is the only one of four identical-window siblings without a row.
